items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: He also was with, on the same recording with, with, he used to be with Pichon, not Pichon, Piron, A.J. Piron.

ctx.x: Well, this is not earlier than that. This is earlier than that. But Louis had his first band.
He also was with, on the same recording with, with, he used to be with Pichon, not Pichon, Piron, A.J. Piron. And he also, well, he was one of the better musicians around.
You know, I think of Warnick and T.O. and, uh, Ninn, but this guy was a reader, huh?
